# BotGhost Documentation

We warmly welcome you to the BotGhost Documentation!

<p align="center"><a href="#get-started-with-botghost" class="button primary">View Topics</a><button type="button" class="button primary" data-action="search" data-icon="magnifying-glass">Search anything...</button></p>

Thank you for choosing BotGhost! We're excited to help you on your journey to creating your own custom BotGhost bot! Here you'll find everything you need to build and customize your bot.

To get started, **ask our AI** a question or check out the **main topics** below. You can also explore our **Table of Contents** on the left, and select the feature you're interested in.\
If your question is not answered on one of the pages, do not hesitate to join our Discord server at [discord.gg/botghost](https://discord.gg/botghost) for further support!

Happy building!
